kit.hero_spec: 10 ft x 1.5 ft (305 x 46 cm) mat, wrinkle-resistant crystal-velvet or woven nylon surface at a stated stimp (about 10 to 11), 5 mm natural-rubber backing, two holes (regulation 4.25 in and 2.56 in practice), solid-wood magnetic ball-return track and hole frame, distance marks every foot. Premium vs the $64-76 Amazon mat in measurable terms: printed stimp rating tested on a ramp, 5 mm vs 3 mm backing, laid flat out of the box (no-crease folding or roller core), 2-year warranty. Weight capacity and certifications not applicable (no electronics, no UL/FCC). Width capped at 1.5 ft so the carton stays at or under 22 in (USPS length surcharge).

landed.addon_cost: $8 per kit base ($6 at volume, $10 small batch), ASSUMED except mirror (ESTIMATED $2.66 FOB at 500)
landed.delivery_path: No US-warehouse dropshipper with a listed putting mat found (CJ catalog search found none; Faire Zummy listing blocked; WeDropship VERPEAK out of stock). Only workable path: import 25-50 kits to a US 3PL (or Amazon MCF) and ship USPS Ground Advantage. 50 kits x ~$40 FOB = ~$2,000 plus freight and duties, which exceeds the whole $1,800 budget; 20 kits = ~$800 product + ~$700 freight/duties/entry, still over the $300 working-capital line. Direct-from-China parcels are out of scope.
landed.carton_dims_in: Base 18 x 13 x 8 (ASSUMED, from comparables: Perfect Practice gift box 16.3 x 11.5 x 6.5 per Golfers Authority; Dachenus 17.3 x 13.4 x 6.7, 9.1 lb; GimiYaa 16.1 x 11.8 x 6.3, 3.5 lb per DataForSEO ASIN data). A 3 x 10 ft turf mat rolls into a ~38 x 10 x 10 carton (bzartificialturf 1.5 x 3 m mat ships 150 x 40 x 40 cm, 23 kg).
landed.billable_weight_lb: USPS: 1,872 cu in / 166 = 11.3 -> 12 lb (over 1 cu ft so dim applies). UPS/FedEx retail: 1,872 / 139 = 13.5 -> 14 lb. 3 x 10 ft roll: 3,800 / 166 = 23 lb USPS, 3,800 / 139 = 28 lb UPS.

shipping_per_order.3x10_ft_roll: about $66.80 zone 5 ($35.80 for 23 lb + $10 length >30 in + $21 over 2 cu ft) -> a 3x10 ft hero is not viable

fit.customer: Male golfer 35-65, handicap 10-25, plays 20+ rounds a year, practices at home in winter; or a partner buying him a gift (Q4). Desk-and-office golfers (tech workers putting at the office) are a natural sub-segment Dhruv knows.
fit.positioning: Against Dachenus at $76: the same format sold with a stated, tested speed, a flat-shipped (not creased) mat, and a structured 30-day plan with progress tracking. Against Perfect Practice at $150: no celebrity, so it must win on the plan and software. Honest read: the hero is a commodity sold by 50+ Amazon sellers and the premium slot is held by an endorsed brand.
fit.software_edge: Phone putting tracker (log makes per distance, streaks), drill programme by handicap, quiz picking mat length; QR in box. Real but replicable, and golf apps (e.g., free drill apps) already exist.
fit.reorder: Weak. No consumable; possible add-ons (pressure-putt target, chipping net, break shims, replacement turf) and gifts. Mostly one-time purchase.
fit.seasonality: Google (US, DataForSEO): putting mat Nov-25 8,100, Dec-25 9,900, Jan-26 5,400, then 4,400-5,400 all year; indoor putting green Dec-25 18,100 -> Jan-26 6,600; golf training aids holds in Jan-26 (9,900, equal to Dec) and Feb-Apr 8,100; golf gifts Dec-25 110,000 -> Jan-26 8,100. January is the post-gift trough for mats (about 55% of December, near the annual baseline) but strong for training aids (pre-season practice). A Jan 4 test misses the gift peak; the best mat window is Nov-Dec.
risks: Economics fail the cushion at $139-149 on small-batch import costs (base pre-ad $30.16, target CAC $22.62 vs benchmark $44.53, cushion ratio 0.51; tough case -$27.73)
Cash: a 25-50 kit import costs $1,000-2,000+ before ads, larger than the budget lines
No US-warehouse dropship source with a price found
Commodity: 50+ near-identical Amazon mats at $40-80; premium slot held by endorsed Perfect Practice
Active design patents on putting greens (D994815, D1005430, D967315) unreviewed vs supplier designs
January demand trough for mats; Q4 gift peak would be missed
Duty rate under July 2026 Section 301 for China UNKNOWN
